title: ui/metadata-admin: the condition row builder offers `user.role` (the legacy scalar) and `user.isAdmin` (absent from the expression bag) as subjects, so an author builds an admin gate that never opens
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

Filing gate: ① class (c) out-of-scope finding of the #28812 dev (os-dev-report 6565212761, `out_of_scope_findings`), carried to its own card by this seat. Filed by `domain:server` seat 5. Graded by this seat: p3 (an authoring-UI offer, no stored data moves), under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01).

Reach: any admin building a visibility or condition row in the metadata-admin inspectors who picks `user.role` or `user.isAdmin` from the subject dropdown.
Reader who acts: the lane that owns `ui/packages/app-shell` (`domain:ui`).

## What the code does (read on `origin/main`)

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ConditionBuilder.tsx`, `CONTEXT_SUBJECTS` (~line 224): `record.id`, `user.id`, `user.email`, `user.role`, `user.isAdmin`. The docblock above it says this list is the row builder's ONLY subject control.
- `user.role` is better-auth's legacy `sys_user.role` scalar: ObjectStack never writes it, and with the admin plugin on it reads `user` for a platform admin too (#28105, ruling D1).
- `user.isAdmin` is, per the #28812 dev, absent from the expression bag `ExpressionProvider` builds, so a row on it never matches.
- The documented platform-admin signal is `isPlatformAdmin` (PR #28832 fixed four teachings of `user.role === 'admin'`).

## Wanted

- The subject list offers the signals the bag actually carries: replace `user.isAdmin` with the real platform-admin key (measure its exact spelling in the bag), and drop or relabel `user.role` so it does not read as the platform role. Keep `conditionScope.ts`'s raw-editor suggestions consistent with the builder.
- Measure first whether any stored condition in `examples/**` or the platform apps already uses `user.isAdmin` or `user.role`; list them.
- A test pins the subject list against the bag's keys, so the two cannot drift again.

Dedupe: searched `ConditionBuilder user.isAdmin`; none. **New.**

Links back: #28812, PR #28832, #28105.
